items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Little Brother; the mention is solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: I think it was Little Brother that told me... Wait a minute, it's coming back a bit now. I think he was from the town outside of New Orleans where Little Brother was from, which is some logging town out there...oh Lord... Anyway, I've heard of him.
You were asking about the union before. Well, before we left Houston, Texas, we joined the union.
